name: cc-bus-waker
description: Wakes idle Claude Code terminals in this VS Code window when a cc-chat message arrives, and opens new claude tabs on request (cc-msg spawn).

ccBusWaker.enabled.description: Wake idle Claude Code terminals when a cc-chat message arrives.

ccBusWaker.idleSeconds.description: Only wake a session whose transcript has been idle this many seconds (i.e. not mid-generation).

ccBusWaker.pollMs.description: How often (ms) to scan the cc-chat inboxes and spawn queue.

ccBusWaker.nudgeText.description: Short line sent to the terminal so Claude takes a turn and the hook delivers the message.

ccBusWaker.skipActiveTerminal.description: Never nudge the terminal you're currently in (protects text you're typing).

ccBusWaker.notify.description: Show a short toast when a background session receives a message or a new tab is opened.

ccBusWaker.renameTerminals.description: Rename terminal tabs to their cc-chat bus label. OFF by default: a manual name overrides Claude Code's dynamic title and disables its native working indicator (the dot). Turn on only if you prefer bus names over the native dot.

ccBusWaker.showState.description: Append the session state to the tab name (· working / · done / · afk), derived from transcript activity. Requires renameTerminals.

ccBusWaker.stateIcons.description: Set the tab icon by state (play = working, check = done, circle-slash = afk). Only works if your VS Code exposes a changeIcon-with-arg command (the extension detects this). Requires renameTerminals.
